description: This file defines the ServiceException class within the OrangeHRM core exception handling module. It extends the base Exception class and resides in the OrangeHRM namespace structure, serving as a custom exception type for service-related errors in the application.

classes.name: ServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling service-related errors in the OrangeHRM application.
